attempts.sql: SELECT SUBSTRING(file_id, 1, POSITION('/' IN file_id) + POSITION('/' IN SUBSTRING(file_id FROM POSITION('/' IN file_id) + 1))) AS folder_path, SUM(line_count) AS total_lines FROM auto_ontology_code.code.files WHERE file_id LIKE 'auto_ontology/server/%' AND file_id NOT LIKE 'auto_ontology/server/%/%/%' GROUP BY folder_path HAVING SUM(line_count) > 1000 ORDER BY total_lines DESC;

request:
Within auto_ontology/server/, which immediate subfolders contain more than 1,000 lines of Python in total? Count every .py file anywhere inside the subfolder, including its test files and __init__.py; files directly in auto_ontology/server/ itself belong to no subfolder. Return the subfolder's repository-relative path (e.g. auto_ontology/server/chat) and its total line count.

Requested output columns: folder_path (string), total_lines (integer).
Return exactly the requested output columns, using each requested name as the column alias, in the requested order. Return complete repository-relative file paths and complete symbol IDs exactly as stored. When the question asks which files, symbols or modules, return each distinct one once unless it asks for occurrences.
explanation: This query lists each immediate subfolder directly under auto_ontology/server/ that contains Python files totaling more than 1,000 lines. It extracts the subfolder name from the repository-relative file path, sums the line_count across all .py files in that subfolder (including test files and __init__.py), and returns only those groups where the total exceeds 1,000 lines, ordered from highest to lowest total lines.
sql: SELECT SUBSTRING(file_id, 1, POSITION('/' IN file_id) + POSITION('/' IN SUBSTRING(file_id FROM POSITION('/' IN file_id) + 1))) AS folder_path, SUM(line_count) AS total_lines FROM auto_ontology_code.code.files WHERE file_id LIKE 'auto_ontology/server/%' AND file_id NOT LIKE 'auto_ontology/server/%/%/%' GROUP BY folder_path HAVING SUM(line_count) > 1000 ORDER BY total_lines DESC;
